description: Standard engineering governance fields for a GitHub Projects board. Single-select options may be a plain string or {name,color}; colors are the canonical palette applied by Apply-FieldPreset (gh cannot set option colors on create). The type field is 'Task Type' because GitHub reserves the name 'Type' (createProjectV2Field: 'Name cannot have a reserved value'); the suite reads it through Get-BoardVocabulary.ps1 and still accepts a legacy 'Type' field on boards that already have one.
